name: HyperXosist Agent Use
description: Machine-readable entrypoint for AI agents that generate X search URLs with HyperXosist noise reduction.
servicePurpose: Agent-facing execution/query layer for building noise-reduced X/Twitter search queries before handing candidate feedback to Signal-to-Fix.
whenToUse: An agent needs to source candidate X/Twitter feedback with spam, promo, and engagement-bait reduction.
An agent needs a paid query/search execution path before using Signal-to-Fix for keep-only PR spec generation.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for free access to paid execution output.
Do not use as proof that paid execution completed unless POST /hyperxosist-query returned HTTP 200 after x402 payment.
Do not use to bypass X/Twitter terms, authentication requirements, or payment.

agentConversionSummary.problemSolved: Builds noise-reduced X/Twitter search queries and search URLs for agents that need better candidate feedback discovery.
agentConversionSummary.whenToUse: Use before Signal-to-Fix when an agent needs to source relevant X/Twitter feedback with spam, promo, and engagement-bait reduction.
agentConversionSummary.inputToSend: keywords, exactPhrase, fromUser, excludeWords, date filters, minimum engagement filters, language, media filters, mode, and noise settings.
agentConversionSummary.expectedOutput: A paid query/search result from the x402 endpoint, including an X search query or search URL suitable for gathering candidate feedback.
agentConversionSummary.paidAction: POST the same query input to the configured x402 payment endpoint.
agentConversionSummary.on402: Read x402-payment.json and paymentOptionsEndpoint, complete the x402 payment, then retry the same POST with payment proof.

agent_flow: If value is sufficient, POST /hyperxosist-query with x402 payment
If HTTP 402 is returned, complete x402 payment before retrying

payment.instruction: AI agents must POST input to the configured x402 endpoint and complete payment before using generated search URLs. Human browser use remains available through index.html.

complementaryPositioning.hyperxosist: Agent-facing execution/query layer with x402 payment flow.
complementaryPositioning.signalToFix: Feedback/noise -> actionable issue, PR spec, and implementation prompt.
complementaryPositioning.whyTogether: HyperXosist produces cleaner paid search execution for candidate feedback; Signal-to-Fix turns the resulting feedback into keep-only implementation artifacts.

lang.description: Use empty string for global search, or X language codes such as en, ja, es, fr, de, ko, zh.

linkedServices.handoff: Use paid HyperXosist query generation to collect candidate X/Twitter feedback, then analyze it in Signal-to-Fix. Signal-to-Fix downstream outputs use only decision === "keep" items.
